==Notes==
*It is the party members of the ''target'' that gets the healing, not those of the caster.
**If used on a [[minion]], all allied minions will receive the health instead of party members.
*Only the party members in compass range of the target will be healed.
*The enchantment ends if the target leaves the caster's compass range.
* Combines well with [[Shield of Absorption]] when the target of both enchantments is under heavy attack (e.g. a character [[tank]]ing).
*Works very well when used on an [[emo]] who has a [[Life Bond]] on a tank.
*This skill will trigger if the damage received is 0, unlike [[Essence Bond]]. 
{{Anomaly|If two people cast this spell on one target, both will take effect; however, only one enchantment will show on the [[effects monitor]].}}
{{Anomaly|The heal amount is based on your rank of [[Divine Favor]] at the time of each hit rather than at the initial casting, i.e. if your attributes are increased/decreased while the enchantment is in effect, the heal amount will change accordingly.}}
{{Bug|This skill actually causes [[health gain]].}}

==Trivia==
* When casting this spell, it makes the same sound as using a [[signet]].
* This skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[Seed of Life/Skill history|skill history]] for details.
